title: KAFKA-17770: use Locale.ROOT when converting server config keys from env vars
body:
KafkaDockerWrapper#getServerConfigsFromEnv lowercased the environment variable name using the system default Locale. Locales with different casing rules (for example Turkish/Azerbaijani, where 'I' lowercases to a dotless 'ı') therefore produced invalid server config keys from KAFKA_* environment variables.

This change uses Locale.ROOT so the conversion is independent of the system default Locale. This is one of the remaining instances of the locale sensitivity described in KAFKA-17770.

### Testing
- Added KafkaDockerWrapperTest#testGetServerConfigsFromEnvWithLocaleSensitiveCaseMapping, which sets the default Locale to tr-TR and asserts the resulting key is inter.broker.listener.name (fails before the fix).
- `./gradlew :core:test --tests "kafka.docker.KafkaDockerWrapperTest"`
- `./gradlew :core:spotlessCheck :core:checkstyleMain`
